name: clio.css
description: CSS library for classic Mac OS interfaces: Macintosh System 6 and Mac OS 8/9 Platinum windows, menus, buttons, scroll bars and dialogs, with every value traced to measured pixels.

evidenceStatuses.measured: read from real pixels of the era
evidenceStatuses.inferred: reasoned from documentation or behaviour, not measured
evidenceStatuses.adapted: a deliberate departure for the web (touch, focus, contrast)
evidenceStatuses.third-party: art or font from a named, licensed project

components.name: Window
components.summary: A document window: frame, title bar with close and zoom boxes (plus the WindowShade box in Platinum), an optional details bar and a scrolling pane.
components.accessibility: Give each box an aria-label (Close, Zoom, Collapse). The title is a real heading; pick the level that fits your page (h1 for a full-screen app window). Buttons keep a visible focus ring. On touch screens each box gets a 45px hit area while its art stays 11px.
components.html:
Macintosh HD

12 items 232K in disk 167K available

A window pane scrolls with the era's scroll bars.

variants.name: Inactive window
variants.note: A background window keeps its title but erases its stripes and boxes.
variants.html: Untitled

variants.name: With a WindowShade box
variants.note: Platinum draws the collapse box at the far right. System 6 had none, so the box is hidden there.

components.name: Menu bar and menus
components.summary: The menu bar across the top of the screen and its pull-down menus: items, keyboard shortcuts, check marks, separators, disabled items and submenus.
components.accessibility: Use role=menubar, role=menu and role=menuitem with aria-haspopup and aria-expanded on titles. A menu opens while its title has aria-expanded=true, while its <li> has the class open, or while focus is inside it, so it works from the keyboard without script. Arrow-key movement between items is up to your script.

components.name: Push button
components.summary: Push buttons, the default button with its ring, the pressed state and the disabled state. Styles <button>, .btn and input buttons.
components.accessibility: Hover never changes a button: it is pressed only by pointer-down, Space or Enter. Keyboard focus draws a dotted frame (System 6) or a 2px #6666cc ring (Platinum), separate from the default ring.

components.name: Scroll bar
components.summary: The era's scroll bar on every scroll area clio.css owns, on any element with .clio-scroll, or on the whole page with <html class="clio-scrollbars">.
components.accessibility: Native scrolling is untouched: wheel, keyboard and touch scroll as usual.
components.html:
The lane, the scroll box and both arrow boxes come from the era. Firefox has no scroll-bar parts, so it gets the era's colours only.

Scroll me.
